capabilities: Convert Flomo ZIP exports into Markdown notes
Preview converted notes, images and audio before writing
Filter notes by start and end date
Merge notes by day or save one file per note
Write into a vault folder or export the result as a ZIP
extras: Plugin UI and commands are in Simplified Chinese, with English label equivalents listed in the README. A separate macOS SwiftUI standalone app (version 1.3.0) is also offered. Imports never overwrite existing vault files and are blocked from writing into .obsidian directories.
problem: Flomo exports arrive as ZIP archives of HTML, so notes, tags, images and voice-note transcripts cannot be read in Obsidian without conversion.

relations.evidence: copy the prompt to your preferred agent, such as Codex or WorkBuddy

summary: Desktop plugin that converts Flomo ZIP exports into Obsidian Markdown notes and attachments, with preview and vault or ZIP output.
